_comment: Inactive Station Standard v1 staging profile for jm-cua-twin-pi. Do not use as the production field identity until the physical cutover. Wiring follows the Dropbox Station Standard v1 guide: HC-SR04-33 on GPIO17/18, MB7389 direct TTL on UART2/GPIO5, ADS1115 at 0x48 with moisture A0-A2 and SEN0262 pressure-loop current on A3.

station.name: JM CUA Twin Pi (Station Standard v1 Bench)

health._comment: Operational health thresholds. Defaults preserve the original behavior; edit these values without recompiling the service.

adaptive._comment: Disabled 2026-11-04 for fixed one-minute sensor cadence. Previous adaptive settings are retained for a future deliberate re-enable.

weather._comment: source is 'openmeteo' or 'noaa'. Open-Meteo uses latitude/longitude and gives hourly values. NOAA uses noaaOffice + gridX/gridY (multi-hour bins). 'intervalSeconds' polls weather as a group; forecasts change slowly so a larger value is fine.

ads1115._comment: LAB PI ONLY: ADS1115 soil-moisture ADC on I2C bus 1. GPIO2/GPIO3 remain SDA1/SCL1; unlike the retired ADC0804 lab path this block does not claim GPIO2 as a general-purpose output. Initial calibration measured 2026-09-17: dry air about 17155 raw (2.144 V), wet endpoint about 6400 raw (0.800 V). Recalibrate adcWet in representative soil for quantitative use.

sensors._comment: HC-SR04-33 direct 3.3 V wiring: TRIG BCM GPIO17, ECHO BCM GPIO18. totalLength 48 in is provisional; replace with the surveyed sensor-to-reference distance after mounting.
sensors.name: HC-SR04-33 Depth

sensors._comment: MB7389-100 powered at 3.3 V with pin 5 TTL serial wired directly to BCM GPIO5/UART2 RX, exposed as /dev/ttyAMA2. Pin 4 remains open for continuous ranging; no inverter, divider, or triggerPin. Provisional zero adopted 2026-11-04 by user instruction: current target assumed zero water; raw UART sample 2167-2171 mm, typical 2170 mm. totalLength=2170/25.4 inches replaces 48 inches. Not a surveyed mounting reference; verify when physical zero is measured. Historical data unchanged.
sensors.name: MaxBotix Ponding Depth

sensors._comment: PROVISIONAL field baseline adopted 2026-11-03 by user request: lab A0 bench references measured 2026-09-17, dry air 17155 raw (~2.144 V), wet endpoint originally 6400 raw (~0.800 V). UPDATED 2026-11-10: this probe's own raw readings ran as low as 5720 over several days of operation, well past the borrowed 6400 wet endpoint, so every reading was clamping to 100%. adcWet lowered to 5600 (observed floor minus a small margin) so real variation shows again. This is still not a true wet/water calibration point for this specific probe -- replace with one (submerge the probe, record raw) before treating this as quantitative.
sensors.name: Soil Moisture 1

sensors._comment: PROVISIONAL field baseline adopted 2026-11-03 by user request: lab A0 bench references measured 2026-09-17, dry air 17155 raw (~2.144 V), wet endpoint originally 6400 raw (~0.800 V). UPDATED 2026-11-10: this probe's own raw readings ran as low as 2515 over several days of operation, far past the borrowed 6400 wet endpoint, so every reading was clamping to 100%. adcWet lowered to 2400 (observed floor minus a small margin) so real variation shows again. This is still not a true wet/water calibration point for this specific probe -- replace with one (submerge the probe, record raw) before treating this as quantitative.
sensors.name: Soil Moisture 2

sensors._comment: PROVISIONAL field baseline adopted 2026-11-03 by user request: lab A0 bench references measured 2026-09-17, dry air 17155 raw (~2.144 V), wet endpoint 6400 raw (~0.800 V). Shared reference only; not individual field-probe or soil-specific calibration. Verify each installed probe with its full cable before quantitative use. A2 intermittent jumps remain unresolved.
sensors.name: Soil Moisture 3

sensors._comment: Raw current from the 4-20 mA pressure transmitter through DFRobot SEN0262 on ADS1115 A3. No depth calibration is applied; add a separate calibrated depth entry only after a field multi-point calibration.
sensors.name: Pressure Transmitter Loop Current (raw)

_cutoverChecklist: Keep this staging station id and staging_ sensor ids during bench tests.
Confirm i2cdetect shows ADS1115 at 0x48 after wiring.
Collect and store moisture calibration for A0-A2.
Collect at least five pressure/depth calibration points across the intended range.
Measure HC and MaxBotix reference distances after mounting, including the MaxBotix standpipe connection.
Only at physical cutover change station.id to field_station_01 and remove staging_ from production sensor ids.
Do not stop the current field Pi until this profile passes an end-to-end cloud and sensor check.
